summary: docs/CLI.md documents the flume-harness bin's verbs; the doc-vs-bin verb scan widens past the README

pins: no README or docs page names a flume-harness verb the bin does not dispatch

the repo-wide verdict and its fixture arm

summary: three public functions name a parameter type a consumer cannot import: PartitionOptions, PriorAttemptRef, RenderOptions

per.section: The package a chain loads through

acceptance: Those three are named exports of src/index.ts, and the export scan reds when a function the exports map reaches names a src/ or harness/ type no entry module exports.

pins: the export scan flags a signature type no entry module exports
notes: Measured over tsconfig.json: exactly these three on src/index.ts. harness/index.ts's three (Chain, EntryExtension, Gate) resolve through the "." entry, so the rule is "some entry module", not "the same one". Same shape as CHAIN-EXPORT-GATE-OPTION-TYPES (tests/builtinGates.test.ts).
